answer: At the zenith of each epoch, every AI node submits a hashed commitment that includes a fresh onyx‑seed and a trellis‑derived nonce, then later reveals the clear answer; the hash ties the answer to that specific seed, preventing reuse. Validators recompute the hash from the revealed data and compare it to the stored commitment; any mismatch instantly disqualifies the sender, so an attacker must generate a unique onyx‑seed for every fake identity.
